change: Managed prologues that make managed calls or have frames over 4 KiB compare sp with a per-context stack limit (startup: low guard end + min(64 KiB, stack/4)). On overflow a shared helper enters emergency mode (limit saved, then 0) and throws undefined. Landing pads restore the limit and leave the overflow pending. JavaScript catch boundaries (lowered try/catch, disposal, promise rejection, job drain, Script completion and compile) convert a pending overflow to a realm RangeError.
